controls.description: Vorticity confinement — swirl energy that spins the flow into persistent eddies and vortices the dust orbits

controls.name: momentum
controls.description: How long the fluid keeps flowing after you stop dragging — high momentum lets the eddies carry the dust on and on

controls.name: ambient
controls.description: A gentle, ever-evolving breeze that keeps the dust drifting even without the cursor — set to 0 for a field that only moves when you stir it

summary.zh: 粒子聚成形状并随指针散开，适合互动标志。
summary.ja: 粒子が形を作りカーソルで散る。触れるロゴに。
summary.en: A swarm of simulated particles that settles into the shape, filling it evenly — flat, SVG or true 3D volumes — scattering from the cursor (or chasing it), tumbling when the shape moves, and always drifting back home

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the shape (1 = default size)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the shape in degrees

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: Color of particles at rest

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Color particles shift toward when agitated — scattering from the cursor or catching up to a moving shape

controls.name: count
controls.description: Number of simulated particles

controls.name: size
controls.description: Base particle size (each particle also varies slightly, and grows as it drifts toward the viewer)

controls.name: particleShape
controls.description: What each particle is drawn as — a crisp dot or square (softness still feathers them), or a soft glow puff

controls.name: spread
controls.description: The pressure pushing particles apart — how strongly they insist on even spacing inside the shape

controls.name: agitation
controls.description: Idle thermal motion of the swarm — 0 freezes it crystal-still once settled

controls.name: damping
controls.description: How quickly disturbed particles calm back down and settle into place

controls.name: gravity
controls.description: Downward pull on the swarm — negative floats the particles upward

controls.name: mouseInfluence
controls.description: Strength of the cursor field. Positive scatters particles away; negative pulls the swarm toward the cursor

controls.name: mouseRadius
controls.description: Reach of the cursor field, in shape-local units

controls.name: exposure
controls.description: Brightness of the additive particle glow

controls.name: softness
controls.description: Edge softness of each particle — 0 is a crisp disc, 1 a soft glow puff

controls.name: depth
controls.description: Thickness of the particle volume behind flat shapes (3D shapes use their own true depth)

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for the rest→excited color ramp

summary.zh: 平滑噪声慢慢变幻，适合云纹和自然底图。
summary.ja: なめらかなノイズが変化する。雲や自然な下地に。
summary.en: Smooth gradient noise that morphs over time

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: First color

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Second color

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for color interpolation

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Pattern scale (higher = finer, more detailed patterns; each +1 roughly doubles the frequency)

controls.name: contrast
controls.description: Pattern contrast (higher = sharper transitions)

controls.name: balance
controls.description: Balance between colors (negative = more colorB, positive = more colorA)

controls.name: seed
controls.description: Random seed for pattern variation

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Animation speed

summary.zh: 底图平面绕横纵轴旋转，适合卡片立体展示。
summary.ja: 画像の平面を縦横に回す。カードの立体展示に。
summary.en: Rotate the plane in 3D space with pan and tilt

controls.name: pan
controls.description: Horizontal rotation (left/right)

controls.name: tilt
controls.description: Vertical rotation (up/down)

controls.name: fov
controls.description: Field of view - controls perspective intensity

controls.name: zoom
controls.description: Zoom in to fill the frame after rotation

controls.name: edges
controls.description: How to handle edges

summary.zh: 指针周围像素按亮度拉开，适合互动故障画面。
summary.ja: カーソル周辺の画素を明るさ順に並べる。操作するグリッチに。
summary.en: Pixels sort by brightness around the cursor and keep their sorted position, optionally decaying back over time

controls.name: radius
controls.description: Size of the cursor brush that sorts pixels

controls.name: falloff
controls.description: Softness of the brush edge (0 = hard circle, 1 = very soft)

controls.name: strength
controls.description: How fast pixels sort — runs more sorting passes per frame

controls.name: decay
controls.description: How quickly sorted pixels melt back to their original position (0 = permanent)

controls.name: axis
controls.description: Axis pixels are sorted along

controls.name: direction
controls.description: Sort order by brightness

summary.zh: 指针扫过甩开像素再缓缓归位，适合互动封面。
summary.ja: カーソルで画素を投げ、ゆっくり戻す。触れるカバーに。
summary.en: Throws pixels along the cursor's path like a fluid — brighter (or redder/greener/bluer) pixels are flung farther, then settle back with friction

controls.name: throwKey
controls.description: Which pixel value decides how far a pixel is thrown

controls.name: strength
controls.description: Maximum distance pixels can be thrown

controls.name: keyInfluence
controls.description: How much the chosen value modulates throw distance (0 = all pixels thrown equally, 1 = only high-value pixels move)

controls.name: radius
controls.description: Size of the cursor's throw brush

controls.name: friction
controls.description: How quickly thrown pixels settle back to their origin (0 = float almost forever, 1 = snap back fast)

controls.name: momentum
controls.description: How much the thrown flow keeps drifting and swirling after the cursor passes (fluidity)

controls.name: edges
controls.description: How to handle pixels thrown beyond the canvas edges

summary.zh: 模塑表面带摄影棚反光，适合玩具风图标。
summary.ja: 成形した表面にスタジオの光が映る。玩具風アイコンに。
summary.en: Glossy molded plastic with photorealistic studio reflections, driven in a custom shape

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the plastic shape (1 = default size)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the plastic shape in degrees

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: Body color at the start of the gradient

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Body color at the end of the gradient

controls.name: gradientAngle
controls.description: Direction of the body color gradient in degrees

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for gradient color interpolation

controls.name: thickness
controls.description: Puffiness — how far the rounded bevel reaches inward from the edge before the surface flattens

controls.name: roughness
controls.description: Surface roughness — 0 = polished gloss with crisp mirror reflections, 1 = matte satin

controls.name: reflectivity
controls.description: Strength of the environment reflections and specular highlights

controls.name: crumple
controls.description: Surface crumple — irregular dents that break reflections into hard organic shapes, like blown or vacuum-formed plastic

controls.name: crumpleScale
controls.description: Size of the crumple dents — higher = smaller, denser dents

controls.name: crumpleCoverage
controls.description: How much of the surface is crumpled — 0 = pristine, 0.5 = patches of crumple, 1 = fully crumpled

controls.name: seed
controls.description: Random seed — re-rolls the crumple pattern for reflection variety

controls.name: edgeSoftness
controls.description: Softness of the shape boundary edge

controls.name: lightAngle
controls.description: Direction the studio key light comes from, in degrees

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Speed of the environment drift — the studio reflections slowly orbit the surface. 0 pauses.

controls.name: shading
controls.description: Diffuse shading contrast — how strongly the body darkens away from the light

controls.name: rim
controls.description: Fresnel rim light intensity on grazing surfaces

controls.name: rimColor
controls.description: Color of the fresnel rim light

summary.zh: 直角网格卷成圆周图案，适合环形扭曲。
summary.ja: 直交座標の画像を円周に巻く。円形のゆがみに。
summary.en: Convert rectangular coordinates to polar space

controls.name: wrap
controls.description: Controls how much of the angular range to use (1 = full 360°, 0.5 = 180°)

controls.name: radius
controls.description: Controls how much of the radius range to use (affects the radial mapping)

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Blends between original UVs (0) and polar coordinates (1)

controls.name: edges
controls.description: How to handle edges when distortion pushes content out of bounds

summary.zh: 边数与圆角可调，适合徽章和几何遮罩。
summary.ja: 辺の数と角の丸みを変えられる。バッジやマスクに。
summary.en: Regular polygon with adjustable sides and corner rounding

controls.name: color
controls.description: Fill color of the polygon

controls.name: radius
controls.description: Inradius — distance from the center to the middle of each side, in UV space (the vertices sit a little farther out)

controls.name: sides
controls.description: Number of sides (3 = triangle, 4 = square, 6 = hexagon, etc.)

controls.name: rounding
controls.description: Corner rounding — 0 is sharp vertices, 1 morphs into a circle

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation in degrees

controls.name: softness
controls.description: Edge softness for antialiasing

controls.name: strokeThickness
controls.description: Stroke thickness. Zero means no stroke.

controls.name: strokeColor
controls.description: Color of the stroke outline

controls.name: strokePosition
controls.description: Position of the stroke relative to the shape edge

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for blending fill and stroke colors

summary.zh: 减少颜色层次形成色块，适合海报风配图。
summary.ja: 色の段階を減らし面に分ける。ポスター風の挿絵に。
summary.en: Reduce color depth to create a poster effect

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: The intensity of the posterization effect (lower is more posterized)

summary.zh: 光束穿过一点展开彩虹，适合暗色光学背景。
summary.ja: 光線が一点を通り虹色に開く。暗い光学風の背景に。
summary.en: A beam of light that fans out and splits into a slowly-rotating rainbow past a controllable point. Transparent background — composite over a dark layer.

controls.name: beamWidth
controls.description: Thickness of the white beam

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Brightness (above 1 blows the core to white)

controls.name: beamColor
controls.description: color of the beam before it splits

controls.name: startFalloff
controls.description: How softly the beam fades in at its source

controls.name: endFalloff
controls.description: How quickly the rainbow fades out with distance

controls.name: spread
controls.description: How widely the rainbow diffuses as it travels past the split point

controls.name: softness
controls.description: How quickly the white beam transitions into the rainbow

controls.name: saturation
controls.description: Rainbow saturation — 0 = white, 1 = full color

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Speed the hue slowly rotates through the rainbow (0 = static)

summary.zh: 沿一个方向逐渐变糊，适合内容边缘淡化。
summary.ja: 一方向へ徐々にぼかす。コンテンツの端をなじませる際に。
summary.en: Blur that increases progressively in one direction

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Maximum intensity of the blur effect

controls.name: angle
controls.description: Direction of the blur gradient (in degrees)

controls.name: falloff
controls.description: Distance over which blur transitions to full strength

controls.name: dispersion
controls.description: Blurs red and blue by different amounts for a lens-like color fringe that grows with the blur; negative swaps the colors

controls.name: jitter
controls.description: Per-pixel noise on the tap spacing that hides banding at large blur radii

summary.zh: 颜色从中心向外扩散，适合光晕和背景。
summary.ja: 中心から外へ色が広がる。光輪や背景に。
summary.en: Radial gradient radiating from a center point

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: The starting color at the center of the gradient

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: The ending color at the edge of the gradient

controls.name: radius
controls.description: The radius of the gradient (normalized, 0.0-1.0)

controls.name: repeat
controls.description: Number of times the gradient repeats. Values above 1 create concentric rings.

controls.name: aspect
controls.description: Stretches the gradient into an ellipse. Values below 1 compress vertically, above 1 compress horizontally.

controls.name: skewAngle
controls.description: Rotates the ellipse axis in degrees. Only visible when Aspect is not 1.

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for color interpolation

summary.zh: 画面像时针扫过一样消失，适合环形转场。
summary.ja: 時計の針のように画面を消す。円形の場面転換に。
summary.en: Sweep the content away in a clock-hand arc around a center point

controls.name: progress
controls.description: How far the sweep has travelled (0 = fully visible, 1 = fully wiped away)

controls.name: startAngle
controls.description: Angle in degrees where the sweep begins

controls.name: direction
controls.description: Which way the sweep rotates

controls.name: feather
controls.description: Softness of the sweeping edge

controls.name: invert
controls.description: Reverse which side of the sweep is wiped

summary.zh: 平行条带随机消失，适合节奏感转场。
summary.ja: 平行な帯がランダムに消える。リズムのある場面転換に。
summary.en: Wipe the content away as parallel bars vanishing in random order

controls.name: progress
controls.description: How far the wipe has progressed (0 = fully visible, 1 = fully wiped away)

controls.name: angle
controls.description: Orientation of the bars in degrees (0 = vertical bars)

controls.name: barCount
controls.description: Number of bars across the frame

controls.name: softness
controls.description: How softly each bar fades out (0 = hard-edged bars)

controls.name: invert
controls.description: Reverse the order the bars vanish in

summary.zh: 斑纹持续生长并在拖动处绽开，适合互动底纹。
summary.ja: 模様が育ちドラッグした場所で広がる。操作する背景模様に。
summary.en: A living Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion pattern that fills the layer and blooms wherever you drag the cursor

controls.name: preset
controls.description: Named Gray-Scott regime — drives the feed & kill rates for a whole family of patterns. Choose Custom to dial feed & kill by hand

controls.name: feed
controls.description: Feed rate — how fast chemical U is replenished (used when Pattern = Custom)

controls.name: kill
controls.description: Kill rate — how fast chemical V is removed (used when Pattern = Custom)

controls.name: diffusionRatio
controls.description: Ratio of the two chemicals' diffusion rates — shifts the pattern character (lower = tighter, more filament-like)

controls.name: featureSize
controls.description: Size of the pattern features — lower shows finer, smaller cells; higher magnifies them into larger cells

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Simulation steps per frame — higher evolves the pattern faster

controls.name: brushSize
controls.description: Radius of the cursor brush that seeds new reagent as you drag

controls.name: brushStrength
controls.description: How much reagent the cursor injects while dragging

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: Background color (empty regions between cells)

controls.name: colorC
controls.description: Accent color at the cell walls (mid pattern values)

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Color of the dense cell interiors (high pattern values)

controls.name: contrast
controls.description: Sharpness of the cell walls — higher gives crisper, more graphic edges

controls.name: threshold
controls.description: Pattern level the colors are centered on — shifts the balance of background vs. cells

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for color interpolation

controls.name: relief
controls.description: Treats the pattern as a raised surface and shades it with a light — higher gives a more sculpted, three-dimensional look (0 for a flat, graphic look)

controls.name: lightAngle
controls.description: Direction the surface light comes from, in degrees

controls.name: childInfluence
controls.description: When a child layer is nested, how strongly its brightness biases the pattern — the preset sets the character, the child steers where it grows dense vs. sparse (0 ignores the child)

controls.name: childContrast
controls.description: Contrast applied to the child's brightness before it drives the pattern — higher pushes toward a crisp two-tone split (edges), lower keeps smooth tonal shading

controls.name: childThreshold
controls.description: Brightness level of the child that reads as neutral — shifts which tones grow the pattern vs. clear it

controls.name: childInvert
controls.description: Flip which tones of the child grow the pattern (bright vs. dark areas)

summary.zh: 圆周图像展开成平面，适合环形图案变形。
summary.ja: 円周状の画像を平面へ展開する。円形模様の変形に。
summary.en: Convert polar coordinates back to rectangular space

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale factor for the rectangular output

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Blends between original UVs (0) and rectangular coordinates (1)

controls.name: edges
controls.description: How to handle edges when distortion pushes content out of bounds

summary.zh: 底图下方出现镜面倒影，适合舞台和产品展示。
summary.ja: 画像の下に鏡の床を作る。舞台や商品展示に。
summary.en: Reflective floor that mirrors the content above it

controls.name: height
controls.description: Vertical position of the reflective surface

controls.name: distance
controls.description: How far below the floor the reflection remains visible before fully fading to transparent.

controls.name: falloff
controls.description: Width of the fade zone, as a fraction of reflection distance.

controls.name: blur
controls.description: Maximum blur applied to the reflection far from the surface.

controls.name: blurDistance
controls.description: How far below the surface the blur takes to ramp from sharp to maximum.

controls.name: edges
controls.description: How to handle reflected samples that fall outside the source content.

summary.zh: 底图按网格或圆周重复排列，适合阵列背景。
summary.ja: 画像を格子や円周に繰り返す。配列の背景に。
summary.en: Repeat the child content in grid, radial or linear layouts with per-instance variation

controls.name: mode
controls.description: Layout used to place the repeated instances

controls.name: cropLeft
controls.description: Crop inset from the left edge of the source element (fraction of its width)

controls.name: cropRight
controls.description: Crop inset from the right edge of the source element (fraction of its width)

controls.name: cropTop
controls.description: Crop inset from the top edge of the source element (fraction of its height)

controls.name: cropBottom
controls.description: Crop inset from the bottom edge of the source element (fraction of its height)

controls.name: columns
controls.description: Number of grid columns

controls.name: rows
controls.description: Number of grid rows

controls.name: gapX
controls.description: Horizontal gap between grid cells

controls.name: gapY
controls.description: Vertical gap between grid cells

controls.name: stagger
controls.description: Horizontal offset applied to every other row (brick layout)

controls.name: flip
controls.description: Mirror alternating columns/rows for seamless tiling patterns

controls.name: count
controls.description: Number of repeated instances

controls.name: radius
controls.description: Orbit radius of the radial layout

controls.name: startAngle
controls.description: Angle of the first instance on the orbit

controls.name: sweep
controls.description: Angular span the instances are distributed across

controls.name: faceCenter
controls.description: Rotate each instance to face the orbit center

controls.name: direction
controls.description: Direction of the linear layout in degrees (0 = rightward)

controls.name: spacing
controls.description: Distance between consecutive instances

controls.name: instanceScale
controls.description: Progressive scale multiplier applied per instance (compounds with each copy)

controls.name: instanceRotation
controls.description: Additional rotation in degrees applied per instance (accumulates with each copy)

controls.name: instanceOpacity
controls.description: Progressive opacity falloff applied per instance (compounds with each copy)

controls.name: hueShift
controls.description: Hue rotation in degrees added per instance

controls.name: phase
controls.description: Seamless layout animation phase (0-1 wraps to the identical layout)

controls.name: zOrder
controls.description: Stacking order of overlapping instances

controls.name: jitterPosition
controls.description: Random per-instance position offset

controls.name: jitterRotation
controls.description: Random per-instance rotation

controls.name: jitterScale
controls.description: Random per-instance scale variation

controls.name: jitterOpacity
controls.description: Random per-instance opacity variation

controls.name: seed
controls.description: Random seed for the jitter values

summary.zh: 半径与环宽可调的圆环，适合进度和圆形装饰。
summary.ja: 半径と太さを変えられる輪。進捗表示や円形の装飾に。
summary.en: Annular ring (donut) with adjustable radius and band thickness

controls.name: color
controls.description: Fill color of the ring

controls.name: radius
controls.description: Distance from center to the ring's midline in UV space

controls.name: thickness
controls.description: Half-width of the ring band — total ring width is twice this value

controls.name: softness
controls.description: Edge softness for antialiasing (applied to both inner and outer ring edges)

controls.name: strokeThickness
controls.description: Stroke thickness. Zero means no stroke.

controls.name: strokeColor
controls.description: Color of the stroke outline

controls.name: strokePosition
controls.description: Position of the stroke relative to the ring edge

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for blending fill and stroke colors

summary.zh: 涟漪从一点不断扩散，适合水面和声波背景。
summary.ja: 一点から波紋が広がる。水面や音波の背景に。
summary.en: Concentric animated ripples emanating from a point

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: Color of the ripple waves

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Background color between ripples

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Speed of ripple animation

controls.name: frequency
controls.description: Number of ripples/spacing between them

controls.name: softness
controls.description: Softness of ripple edges

controls.name: thickness
controls.description: Thickness of each ripple band

controls.name: phase
controls.description: Phase offset for ripple animation

summary.zh: 同心波纹逐圈擦去画面，适合水波式切换。
summary.ja: 同心円の波紋で画面を消す。水面風の場面転換に。
summary.en: Wipe the content away in concentric rings pulsing out from a center point

controls.name: progress
controls.description: How far the ripple has expanded (0 = fully visible, 1 = fully wiped away)

controls.name: rings
controls.description: Number of concentric rings

controls.name: feather
controls.description: How softly adjacent rings' timing overlaps (0 = discrete ring pops)

controls.name: invert
controls.description: Wipe from the outside inward instead

summary.zh: 宽高与圆角可调，适合卡片和图形遮罩。
summary.ja: 幅・高さ・丸みを調整できる。カードやマスクに。
summary.en: Rounded rectangle with adjustable width, height, and corner rounding

controls.name: color
controls.description: Fill color of the rectangle

controls.name: width
controls.description: Half-width of the rectangle

controls.name: height
controls.description: Half-height of the rectangle

controls.name: rounding
controls.description: Corner rounding radius — set to min(width, height) for a pill shape

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation in degrees

controls.name: softness
controls.description: Edge softness for antialiasing

controls.name: strokeThickness
controls.description: Stroke thickness. Zero means no stroke.

controls.name: strokeColor
controls.description: Color of the stroke outline

controls.name: strokePosition
controls.description: Position of the stroke relative to the shape edge

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for blending fill and stroke colors

summary.zh: 柔软褶皱泛着丝绸光泽，适合布料风背景。
summary.ja: 柔らかなひだに絹の光沢が揺れる。布風の背景に。
summary.en: Flowing satin — a draped cloth of soft rippling folds lit like real fabric: a highlight streaked along the weave, a velvet sheen on the fold flanks and creases falling into shadow, swaying gently in a breeze

controls.name: color
controls.description: The dye of the cloth — deep colors show the sheen best

controls.name: highlightColor
controls.description: The color of the light caught by the weave — near white for silk, tinted toward the dye for a matte satin

controls.name: foldCount
controls.description: How many ridges run across the cloth

controls.name: foldDirection
controls.description: Direction the folds run, in degrees — 90 hangs them vertically like a curtain

controls.name: foldDepth
controls.description: How deep the folds are — 0 is a flat sheet, 1 heavy gathered drapery

controls.name: foldWidth
controls.description: Width of each ridge, relative to the canvas — narrow for fine pleats, wide for broad soft folds

controls.name: pinning
controls.description: How much the cloth is gathered at the top edge — 0 is a loose drape, 1 a curtain pinned at the rail with the folds opening as they fall

controls.name: seed
controls.description: Random seed — a different layout of folds

controls.name: speed
controls.description: How fast the cloth moves. 0 pauses.

controls.name: breeze
controls.description: Strength of the breeze — how far the folds ripple and sway

controls.name: gloss
controls.description: How shiny the weave is — 0 soft matte satin, 1 glossy silk with a tight bright streak

controls.name: anisotropy
controls.description: How much the highlight stretches along the threads — the long streak real satin shows

controls.name: bloom
controls.description: The broad soft glow around the highlight — light the weave scatters sideways. 0 leaves the crisp streak alone, 1 a wide satin bloom

controls.name: sheen
controls.description: The velvet glow on the flanks of each fold where the fibres catch the light edge-on

controls.name: weave
controls.description: Visibility of the thread texture — the fine grain that glints inside the highlight

controls.name: fiberAngle
controls.description: Direction the threads run, in degrees — the highlight streaks along this axis. Usually the fold direction.

controls.name: lightAngle
controls.description: Direction of the key light, in degrees

controls.name: fill
controls.description: Strength of the fill light from the opposite side — lifts the shadowed flanks

controls.description: Controls how much of the cell interior is filled by the edge color. Low = center color dominates with a sharp boundary. High = edge color spreads further into the cell.

controls.name: edgeSoftness
controls.description: Width of the cell boundary lines.

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for color interpolation

summary.zh: 形状重组成带光影的小方块，适合像素风模型。
summary.ja: 形を陰影のある小さな立方体で組む。ピクセル風モデルに。
summary.en: Rebuild any shape out of voxels — a flat shape becomes chunky pixel art, a 3D shape a lit voxel model with smooth ambient occlusion, cast shadows, a key light you can orbit or drive, and per-cube color

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the voxel model (1 = default size)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the voxel model in degrees

controls.name: voxelSize
controls.description: Edge length of one voxel relative to the shape field — small for fine detail, large for chunky blocks

controls.name: voxelShape
controls.description: What each cell is built from: hard cubes, rounded cubes (see Bevel) or spheres

controls.name: voxelScale
controls.description: Size of each voxel inside its cell — 1 = touching neighbours, lower opens gaps between the blocks

controls.name: fill
controls.description: How eagerly cells fill in along the surface — negative carves a thinner model, positive puffs it out

controls.name: bevel
controls.description: Edge rounding of each voxel as a fraction of its size — a hairline chamfer catching light on cubes, the corner radius of rounded cubes

controls.name: depth
controls.description: Thickness given to flat shapes (2D shapes and flat SVGs) so they become a slab of voxels — 3D shapes ignore it

controls.name: gridSpace
controls.description: Model: the grid rotates with the shape like a built voxel model. Screen: the grid is fixed to the canvas and the shape moves through it like a 3D pixelation

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: Base color of the voxels (the first color of the palette mode)

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Second palette color — blended in by height, depth, per voxel or on the side faces

controls.name: colorMode
controls.description: How the two colors are laid over the model: one solid color, a gradient by height or depth, a random pick per voxel, or Color A on top faces and Color B on the sides

controls.name: colorVariation
controls.description: Per-voxel tonal jitter — the slightly-off shades that make blocks read as individual bricks

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for color interpolation

controls.name: lightAngle
controls.description: Direction the key light comes from, in degrees around the canvas — shadows fall away from it

controls.name: lightElevation
controls.description: How high the key light sits above the canvas — low for long raking shadows, high for a flat top-down light

controls.name: lightColor
controls.description: color of the key light

controls.name: lightIntensity
controls.description: Strength of the key light

controls.name: ambientColor
controls.description: Sky color of the ambient light — the fill on faces the key light misses

controls.name: ambient
controls.description: Strength of the ambient sky/ground fill

controls.name: shadows
controls.description: Darkness of the shadows voxels cast onto each other

controls.name: shadowSoftness
controls.description: Penumbra of the cast shadows — 0 is razor sharp, higher spreads the light into a soft area source whose shadows sharpen at contact

controls.name: ao
controls.description: Ambient occlusion in the creases between voxels — the soft contact darkening that sells the geometry

controls.name: glossiness
controls.description: How tight the specular highlight is — satin plastic at 0, lacquered at 1

controls.name: specular
controls.description: Strength of the specular highlight and the fresnel rim on grazing faces

controls.name: seams
controls.description: Dark seam lines along every voxel edge — 0 for seamless blocks, higher for a drawn-outline brick look

summary.zh: 半透明水面起浪并泛起泡沫，适合水质感图标。
summary.ja: 半透明の水に波や泡が立つ。水の質感を持つアイコンに。
summary.en: Translucent water — a refractive, light-absorbing body that deepens to its color with thickness, wrapped in a wind-driven wave surface that reflects a procedural sky, with Fresnel-bright grazing edges and foam breaking on the crests and shoreline

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the water shape (1 = default size)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the water shape in degrees

controls.name: waterColor
controls.description: The color the water saturates toward with depth

controls.name: clarity
controls.description: How much of the reflected sky transmits through the body

controls.name: depth
controls.description: How quickly the water darkens and saturates toward its color with thickness

controls.name: shallows
controls.description: Brightness of the thin shallow water at the edges — high fades the rim to light translucent water, low keeps the edges close to the deep water color

controls.name: caustics
controls.description: Intensity of the light caustics bubbling up through the body — bright veins of focused light churning inside the water

controls.name: causticScale
controls.description: Size of the caustic veins — higher = finer, busier light patterns inside the body

controls.name: choppiness
controls.description: Height of the wind-driven waves — the depth of the folds that bend the reflection

controls.name: waveScale
controls.description: Scale of the wave fronts — higher = smaller, busier ripples

controls.name: swirl
controls.description: Swirl of the flow — domain-warps the wave fronts into curling eddies

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Speed of the rolling waves. 0 pauses the surface.

controls.name: reflection
controls.description: Strength of the reflected sky across the surface

controls.name: envRotation
controls.description: Rotates the reflected sky — spins where the bright sky and sun fall

controls.name: sharpness
controls.description: Tightness of the sun glint and reflected sun

controls.name: lightAngle
controls.description: Direction of the sun, in degrees — drives the glint and where the sun reflects

controls.name: foam
controls.description: White foam breaking on the wave crests and along the shoreline edge

controls.name: edgeSoftness
controls.description: Softness of the shape boundary edge

summary.en: Painterly watercolor look — Kuwahara flattening, pigment edge darkening, paper grain and bleeding

controls.name: radius

controls.name: bleed
controls.description: Amount the pigment bleeds and wobbles past hard edges

controls.name: strength
controls.description: Blend between the original image (0) and the full watercolor effect (1)

controls.name: paper

controls.name: paperColor
controls.description: Tint of the paper grain

name.ja: 波形ビジュアライザー

controls.name: style

controls.name: colorA

controls.name: colorB

controls.name: colorSpace

controls.name: amplitude

controls.name: frequency

controls.name: height

controls.name: align
controls.description: Which side of the start→end baseline the waveform grows on: mirrored around it, above it (top), or below it (bottom)

controls.name: count

controls.name: barWidth

controls.name: rounding
controls.description: Rounds the bar ends (0 = square, 1 = fully rounded caps)

controls.name: dotSize
controls.description: Dot diameter as a fraction of its cell

controls.name: lineWidth
controls.description: Stroke thickness of the line. A value of one (1) matches the canvas height.

controls.name: softness

controls.name: speed

controls.name: seed

controls.description: Pattern contrast (higher = sharper transitions)

summary.zh: 两色线条上下交织，适合织物和包装底纹。

controls.description: Vertical thread color

controls.description: Rotation of the weave pattern in degrees

summary.zh: 纤维织纹扭动覆盖底图，适合柔软布面配图。
summary.ja: 繊維の織り目を画像に重ねる。柔らかな布の表現に。

controls.description: Strength of the relief shading applied to the child content

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the pattern — lower = larger features, higher = finer grain

controls.description: Contrast of the texture — negative flattens it into a subtle overlay

summary.en: Cellular noise field — distance-based, with selectable feature combinations and fractal octaves

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: Color where the noise field is low (typically near cell centers)

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Color where the noise field is high (typically near cell boundaries)

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for color interpolation

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Number of cells across the canvas at the base octave

controls.name: mode
controls.description: Field type. F1 = distance to nearest point. F2 = distance to second-nearest. F2 − F1 emphasises cell boundaries.

controls.name: distance
controls.description: Distance metric. Euclidean = round cells. Manhattan = diamond. Chebyshev = square.

controls.name: octaves
controls.description: Number of fractal layers stacked at progressively finer scales

controls.name: lacunarity
controls.description: Scale multiplier between octaves (only active when Octaves > 1)

controls.name: persistence
controls.description: Amplitude multiplier between octaves (only active when Octaves > 1)

controls.name: jitter
controls.description: How much each cell's point drifts inside its cell. 0 = rigid grid (banded look), 1 = fully random.

controls.name: contrast
controls.description: Steepness of the gradient between low and high regions

controls.name: balance
controls.description: Shifts the gradient midpoint. Negative pulls the field toward Color A, positive toward Color B.

controls.name: seed
controls.description: Random seed — shifts the cell pattern without changing its overall structure

controls.name: speed

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Intensity of the zoom blur effect

controls.name: dispersion
controls.description: Spectral color fringing along the streak, like light through a lens; negative flips which end is red

controls.name: falloff

controls.name: focus

controls.name: bias
controls.description: Slides the streak window: 0 streaks inward from each pixel, 1 streaks evenly both ways, -1 pushes it further in

controls.name: highlights
controls.description: Lets bright pixels streak further than dark ones, like light rays

controls.name: spiral

controls.name: jitter

summary.zh: 轮廓边缘泛起薄膜彩光，适合虹彩材质展示。

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the shape in degrees

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Rim brightness — values above 1 push the edge past white for HDR bloom

controls.name: rimWidth
controls.description: How far inward from the edge the iridescence reaches

controls.name: edgeSoftness
controls.description: Softness of the shape boundary

controls.name: thickness
controls.description: Film thickness — higher values pack more spectral bands across the rim

controls.name: dispersion

controls.name: saturation

controls.name: lightAngle

controls.name: colorB

summary.zh: 焦点外逐渐模糊，适合微缩景观风配图。

controls.name: intensity

controls.name: width

controls.name: falloff

controls.name: angle

controls.name: trailSource

controls.name: motionThreshold
controls.description: How much a pixel must change between frames to shed a trail (Motion source only) — lower catches subtle movement, higher only fast motion

controls.name: trailLength

controls.name: diffusion
controls.description: How much the trail smears and softens as it fades — 0 keeps crisp ghost frames, higher melts them together

controls.name: trailOpacity

controls.name: driftX

controls.name: tint

controls.name: speed

sets.for_zh: 适合 SaaS、后台、效率工具和内容型的网站，这类产品里动效只负责确认操作、交代状态，所以不会去抢大家的注意力。
rules_zh: 一屏里最多只放一个自动循环的动效（扫光或者脉冲），其余的都等用户动作了再触发。
时长控制在 150–400ms，以缓出为主，而弹簧只用在按钮按压和标签页的指示条上。
不用背景类的动效，也不用边框流光，卡片只留悬停追光这一种。
配色选低饱和的，用一块米色或者冰蓝做底，深色主题就直接用配色组里的深色，另外工具型的界面可以先看鸦青苍黄，偏冷一点的就选清透冰蓝。

picks.why_zh: 按下去会缩到 0.97，松开就弹回来，悬停的时候还会微微抬一点，所以整站的按钮用这一种手感就可以了。
滑块的回弹手感比较重，而且和按钮的按压是同一档弹簧。
下划线的指示条会滑过去，比胶囊的样式要安静一些。
高度慢慢过渡，内容跟着淡入，没有多余的弹跳，所以 FAQ 和设置分组都可以用它。
可以拖动，有指示点，而且没有弹跳，做内容展示的时候用它。
轻轻缩放着淡入，而且有 300ms 的延迟，所以鼠标扫过去的时候不会乱闪。
在中间形变出来，内容切换的时候高度也会跟着变，所以整个流程用同一个弹窗就可以走到底。
在右下角堆叠，最多同时显示 3 条，而且可以滑动关掉。
进入视口以后才开始数到目标值，前面快后面慢，仪表盘和统计卡都适合用它。
先有 6px 的位移，再加模糊淡入，所以段落和卡片的入场都统一用这一个。
指针过去的时候会有追光，但是不动的时候，看起来和普通的卡片没有区别。
就是最普通的环形旋转，尺寸和颜色都跟着文字走，所以放在哪里都可以，不过进度已知的时候，换成环形进度会更合适。
内容还没有到的时候，用一块有呼吸感的占位顶着，和加载环选一个用就好。

sets.for_zh: 适合面向消费者的 App、社区，还有带游戏化的产品，每一个动作都有重量，也有回弹，所以整体给人的感觉就是「好摸」。
rules_zh: 全站的弹簧统一用一档，stiffness 和 damping 都保持一致，不要一个按钮一个手感。
一屏里最多让两个弹簧同时在动，而文字入场只在首屏用一次。
拖拽类的控件（滑轨、滑动确认）要能在中途被重新抓住，所以速度接力这部分，交给 apple-design 来审。
配色用马卡龙和奶油感的，其中粉彩最跳，抹茶拿铁最安静，蜜桃在两者之间，而深色主题里主色要保持亮，不要压暗。

picks.why_zh: 指针一靠近，按钮就会被吸过去，按下去以后再回弹，不过强度不要超过 0.5。
idle、loading、success 三个状态都在同一个按钮里流转，而且宽度会跟着变。
要滑到底才会生效，中途松手就弹回去，所以删除、支付这类操作适合用它。
图标的圆钮点开以后会展开出文字，收起来的时候再弹回去。
选中的那个圆点会在图标之间跳过去，是程序坞的那种样子。
展开的那一项会和相邻的项弹开一点距离，收起来的时候再归位。
可以拖拽，而且带惯性，商品和卡片流都适合用它。
拇指落到刻度上的时候，会弹一下。
数字是一位一位翻滚的，所以价格和计数的变化可以用它。
按词一个个弹起来，同时去掉模糊，只用在首屏的标题上。
跟着指针倾斜，不过 10° 以内就够了。
指针一靠近，点阵就会避让开，所以能给「好摸」的感觉再加一层。
从底部形变着升上来，而且在手机上用起来更顺手。
在顶部居中堆叠，而且状态会从 loading 变成 success。
三个点来回弹跳，和全站的弹簧是同一个脾气。

sets.for_zh: 适合产品首页、发布页和活动页，可以留一两处大动作来抓眼球，其余的地方保持克制，用来衬托它们。
rules_zh: 一屏里只留一个主角，背景（流星或者轨道）和卡片流光选一个，不要叠在一起。
文字动效只用在首屏标题和一句副标上，而正文段落就用克制那一套里的模糊淡入。
撒花只在真的完成了一件事（付款、注册成功）的时候放一次。
配色用高饱和的撞色，配上深色的底，而且落地页首屏要用深色主题，这三组配色都能撑起大面积的渐变或者光效背景。

picks.why_zh: 边缘有一束光绕着走，整个页面只有主 CTA 用它。
悬停的时候颜色会从一侧填满，所以和主按钮的光能分出主次。
一个词一个词地从模糊里升上来入场。
有一道掠光循环扫过去，适合做「New」「Beta」这类小标。
标题里的某一个词，每 2.5 秒会换一次。
指针扫过去的时候，字会一个一个变粗，适合做导航和大标题的悬停彩蛋。
元素会掉下来，也能拖动，不过只放一处就够了。
流星雨铺在首屏的背后，如果想要更「产品」一点，就换成环绕轨道。
有一道光沿着卡片边框跑，不过它和背景只能选一个。
用弹簧驱动的滚动数字，可以拿来做「10,000+ 用户」这样的展示。
评价和 logo 做成走马灯，而且悬停的时候会停下来。
注册、付款成功的时候，撒一次花。
带拖尾的彗星旋转，所以配得上华丽的首屏。

refs.name: Design Spells
refs.zh_name: 真实产品里的魔法细节
refs.summary_zh: 338 条真实产品里的微交互、彩蛋和节日惊喜录屏（Sudoku a Day 的 sheet 转场、Pinterest 长按菜单、ChatGPT 的选项动画…），每条一个短视频。站内标签 Mobile / Desktop / Interaction / Easter Egg / Skeuomorphic / Fun / Apple / Animation / 404 / Motion / Occasion 是页内筛选，没有独立链接。
refs.when_zh: 没灵感、想看别人怎么把一个小细节做出惊喜、想给产品加彩蛋或节日限定时来这里翻十分钟。

refs.name: Ripplix
refs.zh_name: 7000+ 真实 App 动效录屏
refs.summary_zh: 按组件与手势分类的真实 App 动效录屏，覆盖手机、网页、手表。看的是别人已经上线的东西。
refs.when_zh: 做移动端交互、想看某类手势（下拉、滑动删除、底部弹层）在真实 App 里的节奏时。

refs.name: Page Flows
refs.zh_name: 10 万条真实产品的用户流程录屏
refs.summary_zh: Airbnb、Uber、Netflix 等产品的注册、引导、付费、搜索等完整流程录屏，按流程类型检索。
refs.when_zh: 要设计一整条流程（onboarding、结账、邀请）而不是单个组件时。

refs.name: Mobbin
refs.zh_name: 40 万张真实 App / 网页截图
refs.summary_zh: 按产品、页面类型、UI 元素检索的真实截图库，移动端和网页都有；vela 设计检查单里查产品 UI 时也用它。
refs.when_zh: 定整页布局、看某类页面（设置页、空态、付费墙）主流长什么样时。

refs.name: Refero
refs.zh_name: 网页与 iOS 的 UI 参考库
refs.summary_zh: 几万张网页和 iOS 截图，按页面、组件、行业检索；姊妹站 Refero Styles 把 2000+ 产品的风格整理成 AI 可读的 DESIGN.md。
refs.when_zh: 找某个具体组件（定价表、筛选器、空态）的成熟做法时。

refs.name: Refero Styles
refs.zh_name: 2000+ 产品的 DESIGN.md 风格库
refs.summary_zh: 每个产品一页：截图、配色、字体、间距，外加一份 AI 能直接读的 DESIGN.md。和我们「先定风格再批量出页」的做法是同一条路。
refs.when_zh: 新项目要定风格底子、想照着某个成熟产品的规范起步时，拿它的 DESIGN.md 当起点。

refs.name: Godly
refs.zh_name: 网页设计灵感精选
refs.summary_zh: 人工挑选的网站作品，偏品牌与作品集类，带完整截图和跳转。
refs.when_zh: 做品牌落地页、作品集，想看这一年最火的网页长什么样时。

refs.name: Lapa Ninja
refs.zh_name: 7300+ 落地页案例
refs.summary_zh: 落地页专库，SaaS、电商、作品集都有，附截图和视频。
refs.when_zh: 做首页、发布页，要看同行业的首屏和转化结构时。

refs.name: SaaS UI
refs.zh_name: Notion / Linear 等 SaaS 的界面模式
refs.summary_zh: 100+ 个 SaaS 产品的真实界面按模式整理：设置、表格、侧栏、空态、引导。
refs.when_zh: 做后台、工具型产品，要看 Linear、Notion 这类是怎么处理某个界面的。

refs.name: Dark Mode Design
refs.zh_name: 深色网站精选
refs.summary_zh: 只收深色模式做得好的网站。
refs.when_zh: 产品定了深色基调，要看深色下的层级、光效、对比怎么处理时。

refs.name: Apple Design Awards
refs.zh_name: 苹果设计奖历年获奖 App
refs.summary_zh: 每年的获奖与入围 App，共性是克制干净、细节打磨足、留白配色动效都舒服。做 iOS 界面前先看它们，再配合 apple-hig。
refs.when_zh: 做 App、想校准「高级感」的标准时先看一遍。

refs.name: The Component Gallery
refs.zh_name: 各大设计系统里的组件对照
refs.summary_zh: 把几十个设计系统的同名组件放在一起看：按钮、弹窗、提示框各家怎么叫、怎么做。说组件时用词更准，我做出来的就更规范。
refs.when_zh: 描述需求时不知道某个控件该叫什么、标准长什么样时。

refs.name: Brand Archive
refs.zh_name: 全球品牌的 Logo、字体、配色资料库
refs.summary_zh: 查一个品牌用什么字体、什么色、Logo 怎么落地，用来搭自己的品牌视觉体系。
refs.when_zh: 定品牌视觉、找配色和字体搭配的参照时。

refs.name: The Index
refs.zh_name: 顶尖设计师与工作室作品索引
refs.summary_zh: 设计工作室、独立设计师、字体厂牌的精选索引，小众高级。
refs.when_zh: 想摆脱模板感、找一个有辨识度的视觉方向时。

refs.name: Deck Gallery
refs.zh_name: 高质量演示文稿与品牌手册
refs.summary_zh: 品牌规范、作品集、项目报告、商业 Pitch 的精选 deck。
refs.when_zh: 做 PPT、品牌手册、路演材料找参考时（配合 huashu-design）。

refs.name: uilabs · Emil Kowalski
refs.zh_name: Emil 的精细 UI 实验室
refs.summary_zh: Sonner / Vaul 作者的动效实验，每一个都是「该怎么动」的教科书；配套的 emil-design-eng skill 已装。
refs.when_zh: 想看某个微交互（toast、抽屉、按钮）做到极致是什么样时。

refs.name: Rauno · Craft
refs.zh_name: Rauno 的交互细节手记
refs.summary_zh: Vercel 设计工程师的交互笔记，每条讲一个细节为什么这样做；Skiper UI 就是照它的理念做的。
refs.when_zh: 想理解「为什么这个动效对、那个不对」时。

refs.name: Motion · Examples
refs.zh_name: Motion 官方示例 330+
refs.summary_zh: 动画引擎官方示例：layout 动画、手势、滚动驱动、SVG 路径、共享元素转场，附完整源码。
refs.when_zh: 目录里的组件不够用、要自己写一个机制（共享布局转场、滚动联动）时。

refs.name: Codrops
refs.zh_name: 创意网页实验与教程
refs.access_note: 免费（各 demo 许可另核）
refs.summary_zh: 2009 年至今的网页创意实验：全页滚动、图片切换、WebGL 转场，每个带教程和源码。
refs.when_zh: 要做「炫」的整页效果、WebGL 转场时。

refs.name: Web Motion Showcase
refs.zh_name: 60 个克制网页动效 + AI 提示词
refs.summary_zh: 中英双语，60 个 150–400ms 的克制网页动效，每张卡一键复制一段调好的 AI 提示词。
refs.when_zh: 非 React 项目、只要纯 CSS 过渡时。

refs.name: 21st.dev
refs.zh_name: 1.2 万个 React 组件的聚合市场
refs.summary_zh: 把 Motion Primitives、Fancy、SmoothUI 等几十个库聚在一处，能预览、复制、也能让 AI 直接装。
refs.when_zh: 目录里找不到、想横向翻很多库时；看中了告诉我编号，我按同一套流程钉进目录。

refs.name: beUI 文档
refs.zh_name: 已接入库的原站（125 个组件）
refs.summary_zh: 目录里装了 20 个；原站还有 AI 对话类、图表类、表格类等 100 多个。
refs.when_zh: 目录里没有想要的变体、想看某个组件的全部 props 时。

refs.name: Magic UI 文档
refs.zh_name: 已接入库的原站（78 个组件）
refs.summary_zh: 目录里装了 20 个；原站还有设备样机、背景纹理、地球仪、终端等落地页向组件。
refs.when_zh: 做落地页要更多华丽件时。

refs.name: Iconify
refs.zh_name: 222 套开源图标集，37 万个图标
refs.summary_zh: 所有主流开源图标集的聚合检索：Lucide、Tabler、Phosphor、Heroicons、Material… 一处搜完。目录里的图标板块只装了 Lucide，别的集在这里找。
refs.when_zh: Lucide 里没有想要的图标时。

refs.name: SVGL
refs.zh_name: 670 个品牌 Logo 的 SVG
refs.access_note: 免费（MIT，Logo 本身归各品牌）
refs.summary_zh: GitHub、Vercel、OpenAI 等品牌的官方 SVG Logo，做「合作伙伴」「技术栈」一栏用。
refs.when_zh: 页面要放第三方品牌 Logo 时；商标使用要看各品牌规范。

refs.name: soundcn
refs.zh_name: 700+ 条 UI 音效，一条命令装
refs.summary_zh: 点击、开关、成功、错误等 UI 音效，能在线试听，走 shadcn 命令安装（每条是内嵌 base64 的 mp3）。同类还有 Cuelume（17 条精选）和 UI SFX（936 条）。
refs.when_zh: 想给点击、切换、完成加一点声音层次时；克制套默认不加声音。

refs.name: 优设导航
refs.zh_name: 国内设计师网站导航
refs.summary_zh: 优设网的设计导航，AI 创作、UI 设计、素材、图库、App 与网页设计分类齐全，每周更新。
refs.when_zh: 上面这些站都没找到、想在中文圈里再翻一圈时。

refs.name: Remocn
refs.zh_name: Remocn 视频动画组件
refs.summary_zh: 通过 AI Agent 生成 Remotion TSX 视频代码，可预览并导出 MP4；提供开源仓库和 macOS 应用。
refs.when_zh: 想用文字需求制作视频，或用 React 代码编排视频时。

refs.name: Motionsites
refs.zh_name: Motionsites 网页提示词库
refs.summary_zh: 围绕落地页、SaaS 和作品集整理网页提示词，并提供付费组件模板与 MCP 接入。
refs.when_zh: 要搭网页，想先找贴近场景的提示词或工程模板时。

refs.name: React Bits
refs.zh_name: React Bits 创意动效组件
refs.summary_zh: 提供 React 的背景、文字和创意交互效果，代码有 JS、TS 与 CSS、Tailwind 组合；另有付费模板。
refs.when_zh: 想找有表现力的 React 动效，准备复制代码或通过 shadcn 安装时。

refs.name: Uiverse
refs.zh_name: Uiverse 小组件百宝箱
refs.summary_zh: 社区收集的免费 UI 小组件，提供 HTML/CSS、Tailwind 和 React 代码，也有 Figma 形式。
refs.when_zh: 需要按钮、卡片等小组件，想直接拿代码试用时。

refs.name: Aceternity UI
refs.zh_name: Aceternity 高级页面模块
refs.summary_zh: 面向 React 和 Next.js 的背景、卡片、轮播与文字组件，同时提供付费页面区块和模板。
refs.when_zh: 要做品牌落地页，想找首屏、功能展示或定价区块时。

refs.name: Originkit
refs.zh_name: Originkit 动画组件
refs.summary_zh: 提供免费的 React 动画组件，也支持 Framer 集成和 MCP 接入。
refs.when_zh: 想找可复制的 React 动画，或在 Framer 中搭动效页面时。

refs.name: LottieFiles
refs.zh_name: LottieFiles 动画素材
refs.summary_zh: 提供 Lottie 动画素材、在线制作和资产管理；有社区免费内容及付费服务，并支持 Web、iOS 和 React Native 播放。
refs.when_zh: 要在 App 或网页里播放 Lottie 动画，寻找素材或播放器接入方式时。

refs.name: Jitter
refs.zh_name: Jitter 在线动效设计
refs.summary_zh: 在浏览器里设计动效，提供动画画布和 AI 效果生成，可导出视频、GIF 或 Lottie。
refs.when_zh: 需要先制作动效资产，再交给网页、App 或视频使用时。

refs.name: Swishy
refs.zh_name: Swishy AI 动效设计
refs.summary_zh: 用 AI 制作文字、Logo 和社媒动画，支持模板、批量生成及尺寸调整，导出视频或 GIF。
refs.when_zh: 要给品牌或社媒做动画素材，想用模板和 AI 快速出几版时。

refs.name: YouMotion
refs.zh_name: YouMotion 视频模板
refs.summary_zh: 提供视频模板、转场、特效、覆盖层及音乐音效，免费内容有下载额度，Prime 提供付费素材和商用许可。
refs.when_zh: 在剪视频，需要补转场、特效或声音素材时。

refs.name: JS Canvas App Icon
refs.zh_name: 用 JS Canvas 画 App 图标
refs.summary_zh: 用一句提示说明产品用途、视觉风格和彩色要求，让模型通过 JS + Canvas 生成图标；相比 SVG 更适合这类效果，可先出多版再选一版继续调整。
refs.when_zh: 要给新 App 做图标、手头没有设计师时
